design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (net_energy_metering, category nem).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 4]}; carried-credit expiry 4, anniversary cash-out 5, requested termination 4.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: nem_ext_export_credit_revaluation, nem_ext_estimated_export_credit, nem_ext_move_out_termination and their tools (export-credit entries and the move-out termination). Claimed here: nem_ext_carried_credit_expiry (expire_carried_credit_d622768b, agent), nem_ext_anniversary_cash_out (settle_anniversary_cash_out_8d85c400, agent), nem_ext_requested_termination (end_net_metering_on_request_fe4f3e33, user). Union = all six extended policies; scopes disjoint; no headroom reserved.
[Design thesis] Surface goal: a self-storage owner removing her rooftop array for good wants to end net metering, keep electric service and be paid the remaining credit. Core scored value: the requested-termination payout (root). Hidden chain: the 2026-07-14 bill is the true-up month bill and nothing is settled after it; the anniversary cash-out is fixed only after the expiry entry for carried credit stands, and the termination is not fixed until the anniversary cash-out stands. Both edges value_input through the bank. Breadth: Schedule GST on-peak hours and demand charge (service), 12-month bill seasons/read types/charges (service history), the three-phase 15-minute meter (meter), the Commercial Capacity Bidding enrollment (dr), the battery and capacity (holding), tenure since 2024-07-09 (date), grid access charges and applied credit (nem history).
[Problem-tree card] Root nem_ext_requested_termination (user). Edge 1 -> nem_ext_anniversary_cash_out, value_input on v_bank, form state, sentence 'The requested-termination settlement is not fixed until the bank carries the anniversary cash-out owed for every true-up bill issued since permission to operate.' (negated direction); only the anniversary cash-out writes anniversary payouts, so the state names one action. False at opening: bill 2026-07-14 in true-up month 07, last anniversary payout 2025-07-18, bank 613.46. Edge 2 anniversary_cash_out -> carried_credit_expiry, value_input on an_bank, form state, sentence 'The anniversary cash-out is fixed only after the bank carries the expiry entry owed for credit carried into the closing true-up year and left unused by its bills.' (affirmative direction); only the expiry rule writes anniversary forfeitures. False at opening: 311.86 retained at 2025-07-18 is unused (exports 1396.69 exceed applied 1095.09 under the drawing order) and no forfeiture exists. Order: expiry (step 9), cash-out (11), termination (13); a chain, unique. Deletion runs: skip 11 -> payout 258.45 / surrender 214.56; skip 9 -> cash-out 275.94. Persona names no prerequisite; tools check none.
[Base-invariant card] Expiry and cash-out (subjects nem_true_up_forfeiture / nem_true_up_payout): nem_true_up_rule.settle_once - agreement operating, no settlement of kind anniversary on 2026-07-22 yet (ledger shows only 2025-07-18); termination (subjects termination/payout/forfeiture): settle_once again (no termination settlement before) and nem_modification_transfer_termination by policy scope (the business keeps the premises; no sale, no transfer). The anniversary cash-out of 135.49 and the termination payout of 129.73 are both at least the NBT-C check minimum of 100.00, so both are paid by check. No time gate applies.
[Base override note] nem_true_up_rule's 'At an anniversary true-up, cash_out pays the residual, carry_forward leaves it in the bank, and forfeit zeroes it.' is replaced (declared in overwrite) by the expiry of unused carried credit and the cash-out of the bank less the retained credit; 'At termination the residual is settled...' is replaced by the requested-termination payout plus surrender.
[Factor card] Expiry (4): carried_credit_drawing_order method, cross-difficulty service, multi-source -> used 0 (baseline oldest-first 0.00 result); estimated_read_reserve -> 1 month 91.26 (208.90), near-miss: the 2025-07-14 estimate is 12 whole months back; tenure_expiry_share -> 0.75 (195.60); grid_access_exempt_amount -> 25.00 (12-month charges 428.52 >= 300.00) (165.45); all at baseline 0.00; result 140.45. Cash-out (5): winter_retention_months -> 2 (winter share 0.7408) (318.01); applied_credit_averaging method -> 91.26 (latest 70.25 gives 177.51); fixed_business_retention -> 120.00 (255.49); storage_retention_rate, cross-category dr (not a difficulty, so labelled cross_difficulty null), multi-source -> 0.50/kWh (150.49); estimate_buffer, cross-difficulty service -> 20.00 because the latest bill 2026-07-14 is an actual read (155.49); all at baseline 473.01; result 135.49. Termination (4): early_exit_charge method -> 96.00 (220.93); meter_reconfiguration_charge, meter -> 60.00 for the three-phase meter in service, near-miss: the Standard AMI Smart Meter removed 2024-06-24 (186.73); termination_paid_share, dr (cross-category, null difficulty label) -> 0.95 (136.56); open_period_holdback, service -> 0.20 x 224.79 (172.44); all at baseline 337.52; result 129.73, surrender 207.79.
[Seed] Customer (business, EIN 8315), Schedule GST agreement (active, gas heat), AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter (2024-06-24) and the Standard AMI Smart Meter it replaced (removed 2024-06-24), Commercial Capacity Bidding enrollment active since 2025-05-01, NBT-C agreement 9db2120a-39a9-4eaa-baab-5e1753b55d9c (PTO 2024-07-09, 38.40 kW + 30.0 kWh). 24 monthly bills 2024-08..2026-07 (estimated reads 2025-07-14 and 2026-02-14), per period one export credit at the NBT-C rates, one grid access charge of 35.71 and one credit application = lesser of bank and energy plus PSCR; the 2025-07-18 anniversary cash-out 134.83 was computed with the anniversary cash-out rule on the records of that date (retained 311.86), and no expiry was due in the first true-up year. Bank 613.46 equals the ledger.
[Persona] Marguerite Ostrowski, brisk owner; volunteers the roof replacement, the removal of the array, ending net metering while keeping service and being paid; phone on locate, EIN last four and ZIP on verify (email only if asked for more); confirms ownership if asked; consents passively; runs the termination at hand-over; closes on 'terminated'.
[Verification run] authoring evaluator replaying gold with the real tools on frozen 2026-07-22: expiry 140.45 (bank 613.46 -> 473.01), cash-out 135.49 (-> 337.52), termination 129.73 / 207.79 (-> 0.00). Gates --task 1: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (closure 102 = initial 102), SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
[Revisions] open-period holdback read the latest credit with LATEST only, failing the history floor -> now sums the latest period's export credit (SUM over its billing period end); retention parameters set so both check payouts stay above the 100.00 NBT-C minimum.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the rules, the ledger/bill/meter/demand-response lookups and the persona: true-up bill 2026-07-14 unsettled -> expire 140.45 of the 311.86 carried credit -> cash out 135.49 keeping 337.52 -> terminate with 129.73 paid and 207.79 surrendered. Agrees with gold.
[Revisions round 2 - policy audit] F7: estimate_buffer now keys on whether the most recent bill was itself an estimated read (estimated-close 40.00 / actual-close 20.00 per estimated bill), both tiers reachable; value unchanged (20.00). No-near-miss finding: the replaced Standard AMI Smart Meter (removed 2024-06-24) is seeded at the address; the reconfiguration ladder keys on the type of the meter in service (three-phase 60.00 / single-phase bidirectional 35.00 / otherwise 0), so reading the removed meter gives 186.73 instead of 129.73. O8: the exempt amount keys on the 12-month grid access charge total (>= 300.00 large system). O9: the reconfiguration ladder no longer restates 'service active'. O10: dr factors carry cross_difficulty null. O1/O3: check-minimum and forfeit-rider sentences added to the termination and anniversary rules. U1: the anniversary and requested-termination tools renamed with fresh uuid8s (8d85c400, fe4f3e33). Scored values unchanged: 140.45 / 135.49 / 129.73 (surrender 207.79); deletion runs unchanged (skip 11 -> 258.45 / 214.56; skip 9 -> cash-out 275.94). Gates re-run on the reworked form: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (closure 103 = initial 103), SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
user_scenario: You are Marguerite Ostrowski, owner of Lakeside Bay Self Storage LLC in Ludington, calling from the front office between customers. You are brisk, practical and polite, and you like to get to the point. The storage facility at 4180 West US Highway 10, Ludington, MI 49431 has had a rooftop solar array with a battery since 2024, but the roof over the main building is being replaced next month and you have decided the array will not go back up. You open with: "We're taking the solar array off the roof for good, so I want to end our net metering agreement but keep our electric service, and have whatever solar credit is left paid out to us." The electric service stays on; the business is not moving and nobody else is taking over the building. You do not know any agreement or account numbers. When the agent asks how to find the account you give the business phone number, 6164507219. To verify, you give the last four digits of the company's EIN, 8315, and the billing ZIP code, 49431; only if the agent says one more detail is needed do you give the billing email, billing@lakesidebaystorage.com. If asked, you confirm the account is in the company's name and that you are the owner. You do not know how the solar credits are calculated and you offer no figures about them. If the agent tells you that something has to be booked or settled on the solar account before it can be closed out, you tell them to go ahead. When the agent tells you what will be paid to the company and how much of the credit will not be paid, you accept it. Ending the agreement is your decision, so when the agent hands you the step to end it, you do it yourself with the agreement number and the two amounts exactly as the agent gave them. When you see the agreement is terminated, you say thanks and hang up.

edges.condition: For every service bill dated in the agreement's true_up_month since permission to operate whose bank called for a cash-out, the nem_ledger holds an anniversary nem_true_up_payout, and credit_bank_balance reflects it.
edges.policy_source: The requested-termination settlement is not fixed until the bank carries the anniversary cash-out owed for every true-up bill issued since permission to operate.

edges.condition: The nem_ledger holds the anniversary nem_true_up_forfeiture booked for the current true-up month whenever the carried credit left unused is above zero, and credit_bank_balance reflects it.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Chain: each write changes the bank the next one reads (expiry -> cash-out -> termination), so only one topological order exists. A cash-out before the expiry would pay 275.94; a termination before the anniversary would settle the whole 613.46 bank (payout 391.88).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 11: the termination settles the bank of 473.01 instead of 337.52; payout_usd 258.45 instead of 129.73 and surrendered 214.56 instead of 207.79; no 2026 anniversary payout row exists in the terminal state.

Skipping step 9: the anniversary cash-out reads a bank of 613.46 and pays 275.94 instead of 135.49; the forfeiture row of 140.45 is missing (the termination still settles the retained 337.52, so its payout is unchanged at 129.73).
